decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic extension of the core yogurt range that remained on the website into 2024, it fits existing capabilities and likely has low carrying cost, so the option value still exceeds the case for withdrawal.
This is a very close-to-core cheese launch from 2024, so demand is still being tested and keeping it on the market is a relatively low-cost way to preserve upside under remaining uncertainty.

Although also close to the established cheese business and therefore cheap to carry, it is a newer and somewhat more substitutable sliced-cheese option in a broad portfolio, so its drop risk is slightly higher but still below the threshold for exit.
